items.title: Microsoft Teams Down –  Users Face Messaging Delays and Service Disruptions Worldwide
items.description: In a major disruption to remote work and collaboration, Microsoft Teams experienced a significant outage on Friday, affecting thousands of users across multiple regions. items.title: Russia-Linked Hackers Use Microsoft 365 Device Code Phishing for Account Takeovers
items.description: A suspected Russia-aligned group has been attributed to a phishing campaign that employs device code authentication workflows to steal victims' Microsoft 365 credentials and conduct account takeover attacks. items.title: Identity Fraud Among Home-Care Workers Puts Patients at Risk
items.description: Reports of patients being cared for by unqualified home-care aides with fake identities continue to emerge, highlighting a need for more stringent identity authentication.
